name: VRM_IMPL_PERF_OBLIG_TPLT_B
description: This table contains the  implied performance obligation templates.

columns.name: IMPL_PERF_OBLIG_TEMPLATE_ID
columns.description: Internal identifier of the implied performance obligation template.

columns.name: SATISFACTION_METHOD
columns.description:
Specifies whether the obligation is satisfied point in time or over time.
Values are derived from lookup ORA_VRM_SATISFACTION_METHOD.

columns.name: CLASSIFICATION_CODE
columns.description: Code name of a performance obligation group classification. Values are derived from lookup type ORA_VRM_OBLIG_CLASSIF_CODE.

columns.name: EXEMPTED_FROM_ALLOCATION_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if the implied performance obligation created using this rule should be is exempted from allocation.

columns.name: DEVOLVE_PO_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the performance obligation that was created using this implied performance obligation template will be devolved. A performance obligation is devolved if the Devolve performance obligation option is set to Yes.

columns.name: CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Currency of the implied performance obligation.

columns.name: DERIVE_FR_RELATED_LINE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if attributes should be derived from a related line based on implied performance obligation assignment rule setup.

columns.name: CREATE_NEW_OBLIG_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if a new obligation should be created or if it should be added to a related line obligation.

columns.name: CREATED_FROM
columns.description: The process or user interface from which this row is created..

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
